$comment: Provenance and lifecycle for the catalogs in src/messages/. The check
script (scripts/check-catalogs.ts) recomputes the source hash of en-US the
same way — sha256 over the JSON serialization of the default export — and
validates each locale against its status:
status "generated": unreviewed machine output. sourceHash must match the
current en-US hash; any English change requires wholesale regeneration.
status "reviewed": at least one native pass has corrected the file in
place. Wholesale regeneration is forbidden (it would clobber review
scripts/write-english-snapshot.ts when the pass landed and refreshed
after each surgical regeneration of the keys whose English moved.
Add a locale here and to GENERATED_LOCALES in src/index.ts together, with
its brief under briefs/. Model names record the generator, not an
endorsement: a "generated" locale is unreviewed until the README's review
lifecycle is followed. Review is never a delivery gate: a locale ships and
stays shippable as "generated" for as long as no pass has happened.

th-TH.model: GLM (Z.ai), agent-driven generation in the pie-players repo; the two passage-width keys by Claude Opus 5.5; the two question-position keys by Claude (claude-fable-5-1); the summary keys by Claude Opus 5.5; hash refreshed on landing the wave onto develop (catalog already complete); corrections from a three-reviewer agent review on 2026-10-20 (Claude claude-fable-5-1), applied where at least two reviewers agreed; the list toggle key by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-10-20
